# Code of Conduct

All contributors to **Zeller Industries** are expected to adhere to a standard of respectful behavior.

## Our Pledge

We pledge to foster an open and welcoming environment, valuing diversity, and being considerate to all contributors.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and courteous.
- Use welcoming language.
- Avoid personal attacks or harassment.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Discrimination or harassment of any kind.
- Disruptive or aggressive behavior.
- Posting offensive content.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please contact us at <info@zellerindustries.com>. All reports will be handled confidentially.

---

Thank you for helping us maintain a positive community.
